raw_caption: 14th October 2026: Shakarganj Foundation and ASD Welfare Trust  conducted a very comprehensive and impactful Teachers Awareness Zoom Session at Technical Office Shakarganj Limited Jhang on the topic of Understanding Neurodevelopmental Disorders۔20- Teachers,Doctors,Staff Nurses,Care Givers of Sweet Home and all SAPC members attended the Session۔ Shakarganj Foundation extends its heartfelt gratitude to the entire team of ASD Welfare Trust for conducting this informative and useful session۔
